summary:
# SKINNY McCORD (Percy Keese Fitzhugh, 1928; illus. Howard L. Hastings). Single book, 34 chapters.
Frontispiece: "He groped blindly for the projecting tree" (p.61).

**Setting:** Temple Camp, Black Lake, Greene Co., NY. Founded by Mr. John Temple. Sites: camp-fire circle (masonry, ~8in high, 10ft across), Administration Shack (office; framed rules; Rule XI: office open 10-11 AM, 2-3 PM), Benson Dormitory, Martha Norris Memorial Cabins (Elks/First Bridgeboro Troop), Tent Village, Pioneer Row (big dormitory for unattached scouts), Cabin Lane, "eats" pavilion, cooking shack, grub shed, springboard/diving board, float, big willow where boats are painted, Leeds (village), Catskill (station/telegram), Kingston (store), Tenderfoot Cove, Spook Falls, Henny's Cave, Black Hill/Overlook Cabin, Valley Creek, Pie Alley (Pioneer Row nickname).

## Ch I: Skinny Loses Something
- Camp-fire. Skinny McCord loses tin compass; scouts mock him. Roy Blakeley (worst tease, Silver Foxes), Pee-wee Harris rolled over, Uncle Jeb (old western trapper) stands up. Indiana scout shouts "Ooooooh! Scout McCord...".
- Skinny: shy, blushes, sits on edge of box. Second summer. Elks patrol (leader Connie Bennett). First Bridgeboro Troop. Bought scout suit at Kingston with Curry (asst scoutmaster; Curry's Ford). Suit too big.
- Councilor Barrows. Brent Gaylong (lanky, drawls): "forty-'leven sizes too big."
- Tom Slade (camp assistant) and Uncle Jeb wait for fire to die. Tom: "Hmph, poor kid." Uncle Jeb: "Thar's cowardly animals, and thar's timid animals."

## Ch II: Shadows
- Skinny lingers in dark to retrieve compass. Looks like an hourglass in belt.
- Danny (unnamed yet): ~16, tall, lithe, gray eyes half-closed, gingham trousers WITHOUT POCKETS (hands on hips). Sits on bench at road where sign reads "To Temple Camp"; post with rural mailbox.
- Camp joke: two glows (fire + reflection). Bert Winton (Vermont Eagle) fooled.
- Danny came via Leeds. Did "a daring thing" the night before (escape).

## Ch III: Ears That Hear
- Danny keeps matches in hat; memo in shoe: "Martha Norris Memorial Cabins. Up path from fire turn left--second cabin." Burns/drops it.
- Finds unopened letter under bench. Addressed Temple Camp, Black Lake, Greene Co., N.Y. Imprint: Bently's Family Hotel, Wave Crest City, Florida.
- Letter (June 27th, 1927) from Roswell T. Bently to Board of Councilors: son Danville Bently delayed from July to August 2 (trip to Europe with parents); July check shifted to August; returning with older brother on steamer arriving NY Aug 1; asks telegram reply.
- Walks path. Passes cabin with white pennant. Boy in doorway: "No, you don't... Just keep away from that pennant." Pennant-lifting is camp game.

## Ch IV: By the Dead Fire
- Danny at lake float; diving board "like a ghostly finger"; boats clank; considers stealing boat.
- Reaches fire circle; trips over rope loop on canvas; dark figure rises opposite. It is Skinny.

## Ch V: Face to Face
- "That you, Tiny?" / "It's--it's Danny!" Skinny: searching for compass; scouts jeered.
- Danny: escaped; "you're going to pay me back for licking Dick Kinney." Skinny gripping his shirt.
- Skinny leads up hill to railroad-cut shanty (old switchman's shelter, brush-covered). Old red lantern (smelly oil, once in tomato can). Skinny's private retreat.
- Backstory: Kinney took Skinny's ball, said he was "a quarter of a brother"; Danny knocked Kinney goofy. Pop: "half-brother." Pop sent Skinny $15 (Danny got letter at Blythedale).
- Danny's escape: Blythedale Home (reform school); grape-vine arbor; stole ~30-40 ft of cord; ice-tongs tied to cord, dropped from window; note "Get two hunks of ice to-morrow so you can cool down. So long"; slid down vine ~2 AM; passed Tonley's Corners; hid under boarded lunch wagon; hitched ride with a "wop" in flivver. 51 miles Blythedale to Temple Camp.
- Skinny spent money on suit: only 11 cents left. Danny plans ship job in NYC.
- Danny reads letter; idea: "Hide inside of somebody else... Maybe I might be him." Skinny: "You can't hide inside of a scout if you're not a scout."

## Ch VI: In the Dim Light
- Danny proposes impersonating Danville Bently. Skinny terrified.
- Past: Mr. Burt's Ford joy ride; Skinny kept mum. Danny calls him "Teeny-weeny," "Tiny," "kiddo." Ruffles hair.
- Danny wants Handbook, suit. Mentions dogs possibly tracking him. Skinny, indignant: "They wouldn't do that!" Skinny: "I'll do what you want me to."

## Ch VII: Dark Plans
- Skinny background: barefoot in slummy east end of Bridgeboro; saw archery; Elks took him as mascot. McCords moved to Corkscrew Alley (near marsh by river). Danny sent to Blythedale after Burt's Ford escapade; earlier colorful career ended in Irontown. Danny's mother dead; Skinny is child of Mr. McCord's second wife; Mr. McCord works in paper mill. Corkscrew hoodlums called Skinny "Owleyes" and "Jumbo."
- Skinny sneaks to Martha Norris cabins. Vic Norris breathing. Locker: pasteboard suit-case; Handbook; suit bundle. Skinny only patrol member without duffel bag.
- Danny dons suit (fits him well). Hat tilted rakishly. "Why it's going to be a cinch."
- Skinny: "You won't be a really truly scout." Asks what Danny will do when real Danville arrives; Danny: "I'll be on my way." Skinny: "Will you...not do it?" Danny: "Who makes fun of you?" "Is--that--so!" Danny: "Go on back... don't let on when you see me again." Skinny: "I can look at you, can't I?"

## Ch VIII: Stealth
- Skinny's plan: Helmer Clarkson (rich boy, Hiawatha Prize canoe; must swim lake; Helmer failed, asked father to buy canoe). Skinny will swim, win, sell to Helmer for $15, give Danny money.
- Skinny weighs 64 lbs. Warde Hollister and Ellis Carway (Eagle) earlier failed to lift pennant.
- Skinny removes shoes, ties laces, hangs around neck. Pennant lifted (no cord, one scout awake). Runs with pennant. "He had done it!"

## Ch IX: For Danny
- Connie Bennett waiting. Skinny: "I got it!" Plans to swim Hiawatha Prize at dawn. Connie refuses; orders Skinny to wear new scout suit next morning for picture by Mr. Wainwright (for Boys' Life): "Alfred McCord of the Elk Patrol, Bridgeboro, New Jersey..." (First name = Alfred.)
- Skinny's identity: "a feller with a scout suit" issue. Pride thought: "Danny's hero."
- Early dawn: barefoot, shuffling trot. Office at Administration Shack; Rule XI read. Stands on bench to see canoe in glass trophy case. Dives from springboard (squeaks).

## Ch X: Won
- Fisherman in boat across lake. Sees swimmer. Skinny: "Don't touch me--keep away!" Staggers ashore, groping for projecting tree branch; faints.
- Camp launch (Councilor Wallace, Doc Carson, Tom Slade). Connie: "You're all right, kid!"
- Stut Moran ties bathrobe cord ("champion prize-fighter"). Connie scolds. Skinny: "Can I get it right away?" Vic Norris: paddling Tuesday. Bert McAlpin: train for Mary Temple Cup.
- Skinny, bewildered: "Now he saw that being a hero was a nuisance."

## Ch XI: If
- Chocolate Drop (cook, dialect): gives Skinny apple, sandwich, four cookies. Tells him Helmer Clarkson is rich (grapefruit, figs) and sleeps in cabin with skunk skin on door.
- Cabin: "THE ALLIGATORS OF ALLEGHANY." Skinny offers canoe for $15 (said he'd take $10); canoe worth $70. Helmer: "I'd have given you twenty-five." Going home on noon train from Catskill; wallet.
- Alligators: Ellie ("Sweet-dream Ellie") fell asleep on watch; pennant taken. Helmer quit.
- Skinny realizes his theft ruined the sale. "What a tragic word is IF!"

## Ch XII: Scout Law Number Two
- Skinny to shanty with two sandwiches, four cookies. Danny reading Handbook (p.66 gold medal; p.430 smuggler game). "You should worry." Danny: "I was dead to the cruel world." Blue jays.
- Skinny: "I'm the one to blame, because I can't give you fifteen dollars." Skinny begs Danny not to show up or blame him. Forgets about canoe.

## Ch XIII: Alias Danville Bently
- Breakfast: Roy Blakeley taunt ("Sticks and stones... But looks can never hurt you"). Silence from patrol. Oriole nest (Audubon Prize). Foreboding.
- Danny emerges from office with red card = pioneer scout, Pioneer Row (footnote p.24 Handbook).
- Springboard: Connie, Stut Moran, Vic Norris. Skinny: "If I don't want to wear my--scout suit I don't have to?" Vic: "Let him alone." Confrontation under big willow tree.
- Connie: "Did you try to sell the Hiawatha Prize to a patrol from out in Pennsylvania?" Skinny: "Yes, I did." Bert McAlpin: "If you can prove you didn't..." Hunt Ward: "Good night!" Stut: Skinny used to steal apples from Schmitter's Grocery. Skinny weeping, sleeve wipe, defiant. Vic: "dirty little slum rat."
- Stranger (Danny) punches Vic down. "Do you take that back?" Vic: "I take it back." Danny: "Tell him, don't tell me." Strolls off.

## Ch XIV: The Pioneer Scout
- Mr. Ellsworth (scoutmaster) arrives Friday, can't get explanation; Skinny stubborn. Elks take Skinny as he is.
- Vermont troop takes pennant; Bert McAlpin caught; Connie laughed at.
- Danny hikes to Catskill, sends collect telegram in name of Temple Camp to father of Danville Bently: expect Aug 2.
- Danny avoids first-class tests and merit badges. Pioneer Row: unattached scouts.
- Holman Sharpe: pioneer scout, New Hampshire farm, serious, no troop; Baden-Powell's English Handbook (red); veteran pin fund ($3 envelope). Wants Gold Cross (life-saving; Danny jokes about it). Holman notices Danny's tattoo "D. M." on arm (from compass-retrieval moment). Guesses middle initial M.
- Office boy: "Danville Bently, you're wanted in the office."

## Ch XV: The Serenade
- Councilor Wainwright: "Danny" warns against fists (notice to be posted). Danny: "a guy named Kinney..." Wainwright: "There are those who hit and those who don't... If you do, you'll go right back to Florida, Bently." Danny: "There's a lot of play-in-the-backyard stuff too." Roy Blakeley's black cloud.
- Roy, Ralph Warner, Warde Hollister serenade Holman through window ("Oh Sharpy, dear Sharpy..."; three verses; "badge list is changed... ninety-six more"; "fourth test on plumbing"; "medal for personal health").

## Ch XVI: The Accused
- Holman angry at rest-hour interruption. Roy's jokes (rules changed; footprints; hat-tree leaves).
- Roy's charge: Holman claimed "new discovery prize" for crossing Valley Creek by ford (after Tom Slade's Ford trip to Catskill). Roy quotes Handbook: "A scout's honor... hand over your scout badge."
- Holman: "You'd better look out how you talk about dishonesty." Ralph: "if you want me to make you out a liar..." Holman strikes Ralph (duty, not anger). Danny steps between: "That's enough, cut it out."
- Wainwright appears: "At it again, Bently?" Takes Danny to office.

## Ch XVII: The Masquerader
- Foxes puzzled. Danny to Foxes: "keep your mouths shut."
- Danny expelled. Board: Danny used two weeks of Mr. Roswell Bently's money. Refund: unused $30 + $40 transport (billed to Bently) = $70. Danny in scout suit with $70.
- Danny to Holman: will take blame ("I'm going to be the one that hit foxy silver polish"). Holman's "dream."

## Ch XVIII: To Pastures New
- Danny feels like thief with the money. Envelope "To the Managers of Temple Camp": "Here's a love letter for Wainey and the bunch... Tell 'em I didn't need it." Clerk: "Sorry you're going, Scout Bently."
- Danny hikes to six thirty-two train around lake (avoiding Leeds). Skinny not found by Danny.
- Holman tried to confess; Danny gone. Narrator critiques both boys.

## Ch XIX: The New Arrival
- Aug 2: new arrivals. Danville Bently (real): tall, merry, white scarf through silver ring, white belt, hat with white cord. "Polar Bears of Florida" ("They don't have polar bears in Florida"). Tom Slade, Councilor Tenny, letter. "I know my name if I don't know anything else." "I'll write to my dad."
- Skinny (guide) to Tent Village. Danville: "I'm going to Tent Village." Discusses Robin Hood, hero. Test four: seven-mile hike to Henny's Cave; test five. Skinny offers to be witness. Hiawatha canoe.

## Ch XX: Skinny's Protégé
- Bulletin notice (typed, by two resident trustees): fraud; enrolled as Danville Bently July 1; dismissed; warning.
- Skinny's devotion; Danville stays with him. Howell Cross (First Vermont Eagles; Eagle Scout) invites Danville on point hike; Danville declines: "I'm going out on the lake with Alfred McCord." Eagle patrol offer.
- Danville: "He never told me he stole the white pennant." Silver ring; "Polar Bears."

## Ch XXI: Temple Camp Takes Notice
- Elks puzzled. Canoe: Danville tips canoe with a trick; Connie can't. Elks embarrassed.
- Danville to Skinny: "I suppose it's all right for us to go out in his canoe." Paddles; Skinny in bow.
- Scout from Rhode Island: "I can't make that guy out." Hunt Ward: "He does things the same way he says things."

## Ch XXII: Partners
- Conversation: first class needs test four and test twelve (train tenderfoot). Danville's "dad" and pony. Danville: "I only like Sunday School boys." Skinny: "If I do something... would you like me just the same?" Danville pokes him with paddle.
- Sets plan: test four tomorrow; Skinny witness.

## Ch XXIII: Henny's Cave
- Skinny fears losing Danville to Eagles; Chocolate Drop sandwiches. 14-mile hike (7 out, 7 back). Crooked willow, Spook Falls, beaver dam.
- Cave: crawl under overhanging slab and fallen root tangle; split rock; dark, dank; red lizards ("catch by the tail = good luck"); names scratched on walls. Legend of Henny (buried alive); Captain Kidd treasure rumor.
- Danville feels buried alive. Hears movement. Skinny strikes match.

## Ch XXIV: Missing
- Skinny stumbles over "log" object; match; smoke; red glow. Danville overcome, soaks scarf in muddy water, wraps face. Searches; finds boy (not Skinny) in shredded scout suit. Drags him out. Skinny nowhere.

## Ch XXV: From Above
- Skinny outside, calls. Recalls Charlie Avery (Long Island new boy) earlier poked staff through roof hole. Root in depression; roof thin. Skinny digs with branch, cries, screams, cuts knee on rock. Hole opens; smoke. Snake (rattlesnake) loosely coils on stick, then Skinny's leg.

## Ch XXVI: With the Smoke
- Snake drowsy from fumes. Skinny bound, leg asleep. Little red lizards, bugs. Snake may bite; Uncle Jeb Rushmore said death "about an hour more ner less." Skinny plans shirt tourniquet, plans to stab? (no knife). Shouts.

## Ch XXVII: Skinny's Hero
- Danville hears shout; scrambles up. "Don't touch me." Snake awake. Danville tears bark slab from tree; jackknife (teeth-held) through snake's head; snake bites bark (fangs pinned). Slices, tourniquet by stick (no scarf needed).
- Skinny: "Danny!" The rescued boy is DANNY MCCORD (not Pompy Arliss, whom Skinny guessed).
- Skinny: Gold Cross talk ("A commissioner!"). Danville: "I'm proud, Alf."

## Ch XXVIII: It Runs in the Family
- Skinny confesses entire masquerade to Danville. Danville calm. Danny: "I'll go back." Danny spills Kinney and Vic punches.
- Danville refuses Gold Cross: "I'm a stingy scout." Gives Danny $20 ($10 for Kinney, $10 for Vic). "You visited me for two weeks in camp only I didn't know it."
- Danny's cave stay: leaves, fish, cord. Tea for three: two sandwiches cut thirds.

## Ch XXIX: Just as Easy--
- Narrator: Danny an expensive luxury; "I like Danny." November postcard: $10 from Porto Rico. Danny's later exploits foreshadowed.
- Danville refuses Gold Cross: "Only nobody knows it." Skinny: "It's people knowing that counts."
- Danville's new suit, white scarf.
- Connie's con: Holly Hollis (Eagle Scout, slim, from Bridgeboro; Skinny's Bridgeboro troop busted up) to join Elks. Skinny gives up locker key. Vic, Bert, Stut, Connie flattering. "Threw you out?" "Let any scout say that..."

## Ch XXX: Fixed
- Danville visits Elks: wants locker key for Alf's canoe. Overlook Cabin on Black Hill, $12/week. "I've engaged it." Tom Slade approved. Danville: "I'm not acquainted with my own father?"
- Hunt: "Are you an Eagle Scout?" "No." Connie: an eagle "has got wings."

## Ch XXXI: Holly Hollis
- Overlook Cabin on Black Hill (marsh with frogs; precipice; signal easel; Pee-wee's movie riot). Three bunks.
- Danville and Skinny live there. Danville does not care about awards; "White Scarf" nickname.
- Holly Hollis: slim, black hair, roaming eyes, Eagle badge, 21 merit badges. Asks, "Who's that fellow...with the white scarf?"

## Ch XXXII: The Night Before
- Camp-fire teasing of Skinny. Mary Temple Cup (Grand Canyon trip). Eagles: Howell Cross, Ellis Carway, Holly Hollis.
- Walk up hill; Skinny: "Anyway, they were right, because I didn't have any scout suit." Danville: "I've got my job."

## Ch XXXIII: Victory and Then--
- Race from NW end of lake, SE course; skiff finish; launch with "clear the way" pennant. Shells: Holly leads, Howell spurts, Holly wins.
- Holly swerves, capsizes into marsh, sinks. "Help, help!" Boat stuck.
- Skinny pulls down signal easel canvas, lies on it; Holly saved. Crowd cheers for Skinny.

## Ch XXXIV: The Price
- Boat rescue; Skinny bloody, shirt shredded, leg exposed. Danville pushes Skinny into boat.
- Holly resigns Elk Patrol: "I follow the Gold Cross... An Eagle is nothing but a lot of merit badges." Danville to Connie: "you're going to lose him!"
- Narrator: "An Eagle is not as high as you can go."

THE END.
